messages:
mira: quick heads-up - noticed embed-batching regression for requests >1024 tokens causing P95 to spike. building hotfix image gcr.io/redwood/model-serving:v2.1.3-emerald-hotfix and requesting expedited deploy.
release-manager: what's the rollback/playbook and change window? we need ops +2 eng approvals to fastroll.
kai: change window open until 03:00 UTC. rollback if 5m error-rate >3% or token-P95 >800ms. i'll gate.
sre-oncall: adding KV-cache and synthetic perf probe to canary checklist. smoke job: https://ci.internal/runs/emerald-hot-smoke
mira: canary plan: 5% in eu-west1 -> 25% -> 100% if green. will stream pod logs and traces.
release-manager: please include a short release note blurb and changelog link.
kai: blurb: "Hotfix: embed batching latency regression fixed; backward-compatible."
sre-oncall: +1 from SRE conditional on KV hit-rate and synthetic probe passing. i'll monitor dash.
dev-deploy-bot: deploybot: initiating canary deploy model-serving:v2.1.3-emerald-hotfix -> prod (eu-west1) at 1799993340
mira: deploy cmd: `kubectl set image deploy/model-serving model=gcr.io/redwood/model-serving:v2.1.3-emerald-hotfix --namespace=prod` 
dev-deploy-bot: canary pods ready (3/3). running smoke tests.
dev-deploy-bot: smoke-tests: passed 10/10; latency P95=410ms; errors=0.1%.
release-manager: smoke OK. proceeding to 25% after final +1s.
sre-oncall: +1 final, no KV regression. thresholds set: errors=3%, P95=800ms.
kai: +1 final. promote if 25% stable for 15m.
dev-deploy-bot: traffic bumped to 25% at 1799993350. monitoring 15m window.
sre-oncall: monitoring; synthetic probes green; traces look normal.
dev-deploy-bot: 25% window complete at 1799993360; metrics stable.
release-manager: any vetoes?
sre-oncall: no veto.
kai: no veto. promote.
dev-deploy-bot: promoting model-serving:v2.1.3-emerald-hotfix to 100% at 1799993360
mira: rollout done. pushing release note to #releases and updating changelog: https://docs.internal/releases/emerald-2.1.3-hotfix
release-manager: thanks. if any alert triggers follow rollback: `kubectl rollout undo deploy/model-serving --to-revision=202` and open incident channel.
sre-oncall: i'll keep a 60m watch and update incident board if needed.
